_comment: Operator identity for this host: who counts as 'the operator' when connectors attribute rows.
Copy this file to config/operator-identity.json (untracked) and replace every value with your own,
or point MEMORY_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_FILE at a file of this shape anywhere on disk.
With no file, the identity is empty: nothing is attributed to you and one hint line goes to stderr.
A file that is not valid JSON, or has a field of the wrong type, stops the process at import.
The file is read once per process: restart the services after editing it.
Every field is optional and, unless noted, an array of strings. Keys not listed below
(such as this _comment, or description) are ignored.

description.emails: Every address you send mail or author commits as, including send-as aliases. Matched case-insensitively.
description.github_usernames: Your GitHub user logins. Do not list organizations here.
description.github_orgs: GitHub organizations you are a member of.
description.github_org_actor_logins: Subset of github_orgs: org logins that count as you when they appear as the ACTOR of a GitHub event. Leave empty unless an org account acts on your behalf.
description.imessage_handles: Apple-ID e-mail addresses or phone handles you use on iMessage.
description.phone_numbers: Your phone numbers in E.164 form (leading +, digits only). Matched exactly.
description.hostname_derived_emails: Subset of emails that git made up as user@hostname because user.email was not set. A warning fires when these author more than 5% of a week's commits.
description.hostname_derived_review_by: ISO date (string) by which the hostname-derived entries should be reviewed, or null.
